name: bug-protocol
description: MCP server exposing the $BUG bug-bounty protocol so AI agents can query programs, compute commits, submit findings, triage, and claim rewards on-chain.

env.name: RPC_URL
env.description: Override the default RPC endpoint for the chain.

env.name: BUG_TOKEN
env.description: $BUG token address (for bond approvals). Read from chain if unset.

env.name: PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: 0x-prefixed signer key. Required only for write tools (submit, reveal, triage, escalate, claim, withdraw).

tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: List programs with status, owner, pool, top tier, scope.

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: Full detail for one program incl. payout tiers.

tools.name: get_submission
tools.description: Full detail for one submission incl. triage/embargo state.

tools.name: reveal_report
tools.description: Reveal reportURI + salt to unlock payout.

tools.name: resolve_escalation
tools.description: Arbiter ruling on an escalated submission.
